title: THE WELCOME PACK HAS ONE FRAME AND A LEFT TITLE
why: The critic on the centred welcome pack (2 of 5, better than before): a double frame, a centred title over left content, buttons under the 56px floor and 13px hints. The list border goes, the title is left at 32px, names are 20px and hints 16px, buttons 56px high and 200px wide.
now: The welcome pack has one frame, a left title and bigger buttons.
